verdict.rationale: Cerebras provides a quickstart guide, a no-key Cloud Console playground, and docs with code snippets covering streaming, tool use, and structured outputs, supporting hands-on exploration. However, a probe for a standard interactive API reference (OpenAPI/Swagger) returned 404s, and there is no evidence of a dedicated runnable-example API reference akin to Swagger UI or Postman docs. missing for 10: dedicated interactive API reference page with embedded runnable examples, independent confirmation of playground's runnable-example scope beyond chat trial
